verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own international wire payouts from the dashboard and API (docs-46, docs-53). It also advertises no-fee USD payments around the globe (docs-7), which partly covers fee transparency. Nothing in the evidence shows sending in local or foreign currencies, FX rates, or currency-conversion fee disclosure, and the only global-payment claim is explicitly USD. missing for 10: local-currency (non-USD) international payments, FX rate/conversion fee transparency, a fee schedule for international wires, independent or hands-on corroboration.
